title: CRN Methods Extraction Contract (WP1)
description: Year-1 methods/context extraction document for Cannabis Research Navigator. Scientific enum meanings are pending_biomedical (Shawn adjudication). Technical: provenance envelope, missingness, IDEAS/SGBA hooks.

schema_version.description: Methods contract version. wp1.0.0-draft records remain valid while wp1.1.0 is in draft. wp1.3.0-draft = Methods contract v0.3 (eval gaps, fields only). wp1.4.0-draft = Methods contract v0.4 (pubmed_metadata_record). wp1.5.0-draft = Methods contract v0.5 (pmc_oa_xml tier, source_license, validation split, extraction run manifest; record_id required).

paper_id.description: Foreign key to catalog papers.id. Q7 (Shawn ruling Oct 29 2026, MCK-90): one study = one original research paper (may include multiple arms); study_group_id == paper_id. Mapping rule (v0.3): paper_id resolves to papers.pmid via $defs.paper_pmid_mapping; a record whose paper has no pmid is flagged (pmid_missing) and excluded from eval manifests.

record_unit.description: Unit of record = paper (Q7, Oct 29 2026). Multiple arms stay inside one paper-level study.

honesty_label.description: UI-facing honesty chip derived from provenance (technical).

fields.description: Per-field slots. Scientific allowed values pending_biomedical unless noted technical.

research_type.description: In vitro / in vivo / clinical (+ edge cases). Enum pending_biomedical (Q2).

clinical_subtype.description: Clinical design subtype when applicable. Enum pending_biomedical (Q3).

route.description: Route / administration / exposure modality. Enum pending_biomedical (Q5).

disease_or_experimental_model.description: Disease or experimental model. Ontology pending_biomedical (Q6). May be deferred Year-1 (Q1).

outcome_domains.description: Outcome domains actually studied. Enum pending_biomedical (Q10).

species_or_biological_system.description: Species or biological system. Enum pending_biomedical (Q11).

sample_size.description: N as reported; replicate rules pending_biomedical (Q9).

publication_type.description: Catalog publication_type; keep orthogonal to research_type.

study_type_legacy.description: Legacy study_type multi-label for transition only.

sgba_sex_reported.description: Sex only if explicitly reported. Coding pending_biomedical (Q12). NEVER infer.

sgba_gender_reported.description: Gender only if explicitly reported (distinct from sex). NEVER infer.

sgba_population_age.description: Population age only if reported. Coding pending_biomedical (Q12).

sgba_population_descriptors.description: IDEAS/population descriptors only as reported; no invented taxonomy.

sgba_reporting_present.description: Technical flag: true iff any SGBA+-relevant fact was explicitly present in available source.

ideas_representation_notes.description: Human-review notes for IDEAS/SGBA+ capture quality; not model invention.

legacy_crosswalk.description: Optional snapshot of legacy Scraper column values used as hand-tag fallback for Compare.

study_group_id.description: Must equal paper_id (Q7). Equality enforced by contract tests/consumers; JSON Schema cannot compare fields.

work_id.description: Work grouping key. Preprint/published versions and duplicate records of the same work share one work_id; splits are assigned by work_id. study_group_id stays = paper_id. DOI/title matches across splits are flagged for Methods confirmation, never auto-merged; a confirmed merge requires a new manifest version.

source_tier.description: Technical source tier; aligns with content_tiers.py spirit. Truth policy pending_biomedical (Q13).

schema_version.description: Schema/contract version used for this extraction.

model_id.description: Model id when ML/LLM used; null for pure hand tag.

prompt_id.description: Prompt or rules_config version id; null if none.

source_span.description: Optional verbatim span or locator grounding the extraction.

human_override.description: False if none; true or object when a human overrode AI.

reviewed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of human review; null if unreviewed.

pending_biomedical.description: True when value waits Shawn scientific adjudication or open coding.

value.description: Scientific allowed vocabulary pending_biomedical unless missingness != reported.

unit_as_reported.description: Unit family as reported; do not silently convert across families (Q8).

expert_review.description: Expert-review form record (wp1.1.0-draft). Audio is NEVER stored: only rationale_text and an optional raw_transcript are persisted. raw_transcript is stored separately and is never treated as the label. Sentry must never receive the transcript or any form field.

study_group_id.description: Key grouping duplicates and papers from the same study so they land in the same split. Scientific unit-of-record definition pending_biomedical (Q7, MCK-90).

source_span.description: Reference to the source passage under review.

claim_field.description: Which contract field (key under fields) is being reviewed.

claim_value_shown.description: The value displayed to the reviewer, verbatim.

verdict.description: Required; no default. Blank or unclear entries are invalid and must never default to disagree.

reviewer_confidence.description: Ordinal scale 1-5 (technical placeholder). Scale anchors/meaning: pending_biomedical.

rationale_text.description: Expert's submitted text (after any transcript edits). This, not raw_transcript, is the review content.

raw_transcript.description: Unedited STT output; nullable; stored separately; never treated as the label.

stt_model_id.description: STT model identifier when input_mode=voice; null for typed.

split_assignment_ref.description: Reference to Evaluation's split manifest entry; assigned before review. Splits are grouped by study_group_id so duplicates/same-study papers share a split.

label_status.description: Only review_note allowed. gold/training values pending Q16 (Shawn adjudication, MCK-90).

pending_biomedical.description: Marker: science value not yet approved by Shawn/PhD expert.

reference_value.description: Dev reference value hand-checked by an expert. Internal only; never guest-visible. v0.3: work_id/split/storage added; optional so v0.2 records stay valid during draft. Locked store holds test-split records only; dev records never go to the locked store.

checked_by.description: Verified expert identity; required when status=expert_checked.

gold_badge.description: Paper-level gold badge by a verified PhD rater. No audio. Test-split gold lives only in the locked store. v0.3: decision/awarded_by/work_id added; optional so v0.2 records stay valid during draft, required by v0.3 producers (see field dictionary). Locked store holds test-split records only; dev records never go to the locked store.

rater_verified.description: Must be true for locked_store records (verified sign-in).

raw_transcript.description: Raw transcript text; kept separate from rationale.

submitted_rationale.description: Free text. Format (free comments vs set criteria) is pending_biomedical.

split.description: Deliberately excludes 'train' (v0.3 gap 8, intentional): gold badges are evaluation labels only and must never enter training data.

decision.description: 'gold' = paper marked by the resident PhD as top-notch in structure/detail.

awarded_by.description: Rater id who made the decision.

normalized_field.description: Normalized field: raw text always kept; normalized value pending_biomedical until approved.

work_merge_flag.description: Cross-split DOI/title match flagged for Methods confirmation. Never auto-merged.

rater_id.description: Rater identity from verified sign-in only (opaque id; never an email in fixtures).

locked_store_requirements.description: v0.3 gap 6: when storage == locked_store, rater_verified (true) and rationale_format are required. Rationale is never scored.

rationale_format.description: pending_biomedical kept so v0.2 working-store records stay valid. Locked-store records must use free_text (enforced by locked_store_requirements; Evaluation also enforces in code). Rationale format is pending the Biomedical lead; no structured option yet. Rationale is NEVER scored.

split.description: Eval split. validation = held-out tuning check scored only by Evaluation, capped and logged per run. test values allowed only with storage == locked_store; test never appears in extraction runs.

work_id.description: Copied from the paper's work_id (v0.3 gap 5).

relevance_grade.description: Relevance judgment keyed on (query_id, pmid). Field names/types aligned with crn-eval locked-store relevance_grade_PROPOSAL. Intended to evolve into a multi-axis record (PROPOSED axes in docs/methods/field-dictionary.md, not schema fields). Locked store holds test-split records only; dev records never go to the locked store.

grade.description: PLACEHOLDER 0/1/2 pending Biomedical lead decision on a multi-axis linear relevance score.

correction.description: State records are append-only. A correction supersedes a prior record; records are never edited in place. A retraction points at the target's record_id (never a store position/sequence number): retracted=true + supersedes_record_id covers it. Current record rule: for a given target, the current record is the latest record in the chain that is not retracted; if the latest is a retraction, the target has no current value.

supersedes_record_id.description: record_id of the superseded record (any record type). Must differ from record_id (enforced by consumers).

retracted.description: true = superseded record is withdrawn with no replacement value.

paper_pmid_mapping.description: v0.3 gap 4: paper_id resolves to papers.pmid. pmid null => pmid_missing must be true and manifest_eligible false (excluded from manifests).

record_id.description: Unique id of this state record; target of correction.supersedes_record_id. Must be stable across reruns of the same extraction config for the same paper. Optional on v0.2-era records, required on v0.3 record types and on wp1.5.0-draft methods records.

locked_store_test_only.description: Both directions: locked_store holds only test records, and test records live only in locked_store.

pubmed_metadata_record.description: v0.4: one bibliographic record from scripts/fetch_pubmed_metadata.py (data/pubmed_metadata_split_v0.1.json is a JSON array of these). A null field must have a reason in missing.

pmid.description: PubMed ID as a digit string.

missing.description: field -> reason; required for every null field. Current producer reason: 'absent in PubMed record'.

params.description: Query params sent to E-utilities, excluding id. email and api_key are forbidden so contact addresses and keys never get committed.

source_license.description: License of the acquired source. Whether a license permits storing full text is a policy decision pending Shawn; until then fulltext_storable is pinned false and only quoted spans and extracted fields are kept.

license_raw.description: License text or identifier exactly as given by the source; null if none found.

fulltext_storable.description: Pinned false until Shawn sets the storage policy; widening it is a contract change.

pending_biomedical.description: License-to-storage policy not yet decided by Shawn.

extraction_run_manifest.description: One per extraction run (runs/<run_id>/manifest.json). Maps each record to its split, since methods records carry no split. Never lists test.

mode.description: dry_run builds prompts and counts tokens only; it must not be scored.

contract_version.description: Pinned to the contract version the run was validated against.

git_ref.description: Git tag for a frozen run, else commit sha.

model_ids.description: Exact model string per field group; null only in dry_run.

excluded.description: Papers not extracted; Evaluation treats them as excluded, not misses.

run_event.description: Run-log event. Ids and reason codes only: no quotes, full text, email, api_key or reviewer data.

field.description: A methods field name from properties.fields; never free text.

reason.description: quote_not_found marks a pipeline-set uncertain, distinct from reviewer uncertain.
